_provenance.note: Minnesota citation authorities. The Combined Manual cites its own sections as 4-digit-dot-decimal numbers (e.g. '0013.06', '0018.15.09'); this pack prefixes them 'CM <section>' to disambiguate, matching the pattern this roster already uses for other states' manual-section prefixes (Wisconsin's FSH, Illinois' PM/WAG).

patterns.note: Minnesota Combined Manual sections, up to 3 decimal levels (e.g. 0013.06, 0018.15.09)

cmsection.note: length of recertification periods — 12-month standard, 6-month change-reporters w/ earned income, 24-month elderly/disabled-no-earned-income (capped at 24, mandatory 12-month contact)
drug felons — effectively a full opt-out since 8/1/2023; optional drug testing carries no denial/termination consequence, corrects a false secondary-source lifetime-ban claim
SNAP categorical eligibility/ineligibility — 200% flat BBCE via Domestic Violence Information Brochure (DHS-3477); CE/BBCE exempt from asset AND net income tests
assets - SNAP — $3,000/$4,500 by elderly/disabled status; one vehicle exclusion PER unit member age 16+
medical deductions — actual-expense-minus-$35, no flat standard amount
shelter deductions — housing costs, maximum shelter cap $712 (issue-dated 10/2024, may lag FFY26 COLA), homeless deduction $190.30
utility deductions — a single combined SUA covering heat/cool/electric/water/sewer/garbage/phone, not a multi-tier ladder; exact current dollar figures unconfirmed this pass
child and spousal support deductions — ordinary deduction (not exclusion), applied after earned-income deduction but before shelter deduction
